functions.name: H
functions.description: LOKUP.H: ask the local model; optional context range is added to the prompt as data.

parameters.name: prompt
parameters.description: Instruction for the model (text or cell).

parameters.name: context
parameters.description: Optional cell or range with the data to work on.

parameters.name: headers
parameters.description: Optional header row, for when context is a single data row.

functions.name: V
functions.description: LOKUP.V: the local model writes an Excel formula. Pass the data range so it knows the addresses.

parameters.name: data
parameters.description: Optional range with headers in the first row.
